caseNameFull: United States v. Helstoski and Helstoski v. Meanor, U. S. District Judge
judges: Consideration, Grant, Motion, Rehnquist, Stewart, Took

opinions.text:
C. A. 3d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 439 U. S. 1045.] Motion of Thomas P. O’Neill, Jr., et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae granted, and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Motion of Hel-stoski to defer oral argument denied.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Stewart, Mr. Justice Rehnquist, and Mr. Justice Stevens would grant the latter motion. Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of the latter motion.
